name: mpx/partial-cards
title: Cards
description: Card grid with shared Grid Controls, optional fill-row stretch, solid card background, and optional Alpine page carousel with bullet pagination and autoplay (ping-pong). Accepts card, card-icon, card-image, card-cover, card-cover-small, and testimonial children.

attributes.label: Fill row
attributes.help: When on, cards grow to fill leftover space on a row (a single last card becomes full width). Leave off to keep every card at the column width. Ignored when slider is enabled.

attributes.label: Enable slider
attributes.help: Frontend only: horizontal carousel with bullet pagination. Advances one card at a time (even when several are visible). Editor always shows a wrapping card grid.

attributes.label: Autoplay
attributes.help: Advance pages every few seconds. Reverses direction at each end (ping-pong). Pauses on hover/focus and when reduced-motion is preferred.

attributes.label: Slides per view (desktop)
attributes.help: How many cards are fully visible at once on large screens. No peek of the next card.

attributes.label: Slides per view (tablet)
attributes.help: How many cards are fully visible at once on tablet. Mobile always shows 1.
